copy.headline: Thanksgiving traffic could build near these North Texas malls and highways
copy.caption:
Expect midday congestion near Dallas, Grand Prairie, and Fort Worth. Highways include I-30, I-20, I-35W, and US-75.

As North Texans hit the roads for Thanksgiving meals, Black Friday shopping and weekend outings. Regional traffic radar data from the North Central Texas Council of Governments identified several locations around the area with the most congestion on Thanksgiving Day and throughout the holiday weekend.

story.title: Thanksgiving traffic could build near these North Texas malls and highways
story.summary: Expect midday congestion near Dallas, Grand Prairie, and Fort Worth. Highways include I-30, I-20, I-35W, and US-75. As North Texans hit the roads for Thanksgiving meals, Black Friday shopping and weekend outings, avoiding the region’s busiest routes may be inevitable; drivers heading out around midday may encounter the worst of the worst. Regional traffic radar data from the North Central Texas Council of Governments identified several locations around the area with the most congestion on Thanksgiving Day and throughout the holiday weekend.
